newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to focus more on ASEAN export market.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to focus more on ASEAN export market.

text.p: Thailand will focus more on export markets of ASEAN countries due to the region's high growth compared with other major export markets, finance minister Amnuay Viravan said on Thursday.

"We will increase our focus on the ASEAN export market. The value of exports to this region is very high and is expanding significantly compared with the EU, U.S. and Japanese markets," Amnuay told reporters.
The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) groups Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
Amnuay was speaking after a meeting of the government's export promotion panel on Wednesday.
The panel also agreed to give some special treatment for multi-national electronic companies which use Thailand as their export base, Amnuay said.
"These companies tend to have high export value. So we have to give some special support to them," he said without giving details.
Amnuay said International Business Machine's hard disk drive plant in Thailand is expected to generate export revenue of about 70-80 billion baht ($2.69-$3.08 billion) per year.
IBM late last year announced its plan to invest over 14 billion baht in two hard disk drive plants in Thailand.
It said 80 percent of the plants' output will be exported. ($1 = 26 baht)
